notes: Cross-domain holdout: do not tune prompts, guards, or code on these cases. Revenue follows the catalog instruction (completed appointments only).

cases.question: How many appointments are there in total?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments

cases.question: How many patients are on the Premium insurance plan?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patients WHERE insurance_plan = 'Premium'

cases.question: How many no-show appointments were there in 2024?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments WHERE status = 'no_show' AND appointments.appointment_date >= '2024-01-01' AND appointments.appointment_date < '2025-01-01'

cases.question: What is our total revenue?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(fee) FROM appointments WHERE appointments.status = 'completed'

cases.question: What is the average appointment duration in minutes?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(duration_minutes) FROM appointments

cases.question: How many medications are on the formulary?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medications

cases.question: How many patients live in each city?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM patients GROUP BY city

cases.question: Break down appointments by status.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM appointments GROUP BY status

cases.question: What is the revenue for each department?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT departments.name, SUM(appointments.fee) FROM appointments JOIN doctors ON appointments.doctor_id = doctors.doctor_id JOIN departments ON doctors.department_id = departments.department_id WHERE appointments.status = 'completed' GROUP BY departments.name

cases.question: Which 3 doctors have the most appointments of any status? Show their last names.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT doctors.last_name, COUNT(*) FROM appointments JOIN doctors ON appointments.doctor_id = doctors.doctor_id GROUP BY doctors.last_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3
cases.note: Reworded 2026-10-04: 'saw the most appointments' reasonably means completed visits, which the model did; the case was ambiguous, not the answer wrong.

cases.question: Which medication has been prescribed in the largest total quantity?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT medications.name, SUM(prescriptions.quantity) FROM prescriptions JOIN medications ON prescriptions.medication_id = medications.medication_id GROUP BY medications.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many completed appointments were there each month in 2024?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', appointment_date), COUNT(*) FROM appointments WHERE appointments.status = 'completed' AND appointments.appointment_date >= '2024-01-01' AND appointments.appointment_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1

cases.question: What was revenue per quarter in 2025?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', appointment_date), SUM(fee) FROM appointments WHERE appointments.status = 'completed' AND appointments.appointment_date >= '2025-01-01' AND appointments.appointment_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1

cases.question: Which doctors had more than 150 appointments? Give last names and counts.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT doctors.last_name, COUNT(*) FROM appointments JOIN doctors ON appointments.doctor_id = doctors.doctor_id GROUP BY doctors.last_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 150

cases.question: Which departments earned more than $20,000 in revenue?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT departments.name, SUM(appointments.fee) FROM appointments JOIN doctors ON appointments.doctor_id = doctors.doctor_id JOIN departments ON doctors.department_id = departments.department_id WHERE appointments.status = 'completed' GROUP BY departments.name HAVING SUM(appointments.fee) > 20000

cases.question: How many different patients have been prescribed Ibuprofen?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT appointments.patient_id) FROM prescriptions JOIN appointments ON prescriptions.appointment_id = appointments.appointment_id JOIN medications ON prescriptions.medication_id = medications.medication_id WHERE medications.name = 'Ibuprofen'

cases.question: How many units of medication did Cardiology doctors prescribe?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(prescriptions.quantity) FROM prescriptions JOIN appointments ON prescriptions.appointment_id = appointments.appointment_id JOIN doctors ON appointments.doctor_id = doctors.doctor_id JOIN departments ON doctors.department_id = departments.department_id WHERE departments.name = 'Cardiology'

cases.question: How many appointments did Pediatrics and Dermatology have combined in 2023?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments JOIN doctors ON appointments.doctor_id = doctors.doctor_id JOIN departments ON doctors.department_id = departments.department_id WHERE departments.name IN ('Pediatrics', 'Dermatology') AND appointments.appointment_date >= '2023-01-01' AND appointments.appointment_date < '2024-01-01'

cases.question: Which department has the longest average appointment duration?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT departments.name, AVG(appointments.duration_minutes) FROM appointments JOIN doctors ON appointments.doctor_id = doctors.doctor_id JOIN departments ON doctors.department_id = departments.department_id GROUP BY departments.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many distinct patients on the Basic plan had an appointment in 2025?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT appointments.patient_id) FROM appointments JOIN patients ON appointments.patient_id = patients.patient_id WHERE patients.insurance_plan = 'Basic' AND appointments.appointment_date >= '2025-01-01' AND appointments.appointment_date < '2026-01-01'

cases.question: Which doctor has the most cancelled appointments?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT doctors.last_name, COUNT(*) FROM appointments JOIN doctors ON appointments.doctor_id = doctors.doctor_id WHERE appointments.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY doctors.last_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What was total revenue each year?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', appointment_date), SUM(fee) FROM appointments WHERE appointments.status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1

cases.question: How many doctors work in each department?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT departments.name, COUNT(*) FROM doctors JOIN departments ON doctors.department_id = departments.department_id GROUP BY departments.name
